title: Northwind + Chinook · customer records by shared country
purpose: One server query compares customer-record counts in countries whose labels match exactly across Northwind and Chinook. Counts are distinct within each source, not shared people. UK/United Kingdom, null countries and countries found in only one sample are excluded. The 2026-10-19 observation returned 17 countries; Northwind included two null-country customer records. Source data can change.
